title: Return Stones
description: Return Stones is a simple datapack that allows you to craft stones that can be attuned to any location then teleport you back there at the cost of some lapis!
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d388931f2ea7f9d1c59fdc3b4e66241a434a1ee5.png) # Return Stones Return Stones adds a new item called the return stone that lets you teleport to places you have been in exchange for consuming lapis lazuli. ### Attunemnet Return stones have to be attuned to a location and dimension in order for them to teleport. In order to attune a return stone just hold right click and after 4 seconds it will be fully attuned to your location! Attuning a return stone costs 10 lapis lazuli.
![both an attuned and unattuned return stone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de3ef9478093c9a0d40391bbebee54b857511c85_0.webp) ### Return Sigil While holding a return stone that has been attuned you can see its sigil on the ground indicating where it is attuned to.
![Return Sigil](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1cb81963f7a8d69f50581be51561861ea8e14eb_0.webp) ### Teleporting Teleporting costs 5 lapis lazuli and in order to teleport you must stand for 6 seconds without trying to move. While you are about to teleport your return sigil will make a sound and appear for all players both on you and the point the stone is attuned so you can't use it to take someone by suprise.
![teleport sigil](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/64782894913dfd82d6e6b7a0830464bc1954492b_0.webp) ### Crafting Recipe : An empty return stone is crafted with 2 gold, 5 quartz, 1 echo shard, and a glass pane.
![crafting recipe (2 gold, 5 quartz, 1 echo shard, 1 glass pane) ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7bbd772e5c582a4bf121a8ca632e7d8e8fecca4.png)
